summary: This is a `.dockerignore` file that tells Docker which files and directories to exclude when building a Docker image. By listing these items, we prevent unnecessary files from being copied into the image, which makes the image smaller and builds faster.

explanations.1: The `build/` directory contains compiled or generated files that don't need to be in the Docker image since they'll be regenerated inside the container anyway.
explanations.2: `node_modules/` is the directory where npm packages are installed; we exclude it so Docker will install fresh packages inside the image rather than copying potentially incompatible versions from your local machine.
explanations.3: The `.git/` directory contains your repository's version control history, which is not needed in a production Docker image and would just add unnecessary size.
explanations.9: The `*.log` pattern matches any file ending in `.log`, excluding all log files from being copied into the image since they're typically temporary and not part of the actual application.
